jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent single-frame isometric game sprite for the Botference city. Generate ONE small floating destination world, an island about three 128x64 isometric tiles across (native island width 384 px; output high resolution for later downsampling). Style reference: detailed restrained painterly pixel architecture, mature limestone and slate city, not a cartoon. Orthographic 2:1 isometric camera, screen axes slope +/- 1/2, see roof and two sides. Muted palette: limestone #c9bd98 highlights #ded4b8, slate #58666b, weathered copper #6e9485, warm brick #9b6f58, foliage #72875b #597949 #344f3f, soft shadow #3d5149. Soft daylight upper left, darker right walls. Transparent RGBA background, no background colour, no ground shadow detached from island, no labels, no text or watermark. Lightly tinted glass, irregular foliage, no heavy outlines or toy colours. Miniature buildings should read at small sprite size; uncluttered silhouette. Whole island and all attachments visible, centered with ample transparent margin. Soft tapering underside of weathered rock with a few delicate dangling roots, small drifting cloud wisp. A clearly visible short copper cable projecting below the FRONT of island, ending in a round brass mooring eye for a route connection; keep it distinct from roots. No animation frames. Subject: BLOG world. A cosy compact circular island garden: one clear glass dome on a low limestone base, a warmly lit writing desk clearly visible under the glass, a little wooden bookcase packed with books beside it; a small recognisable antique printing press standing on a side terrace; copper aerial on the dome. Keep the dome transparent enough to see the desk lamp. Lush but restrained plants and bookshelves. The rock underside should be short, soft and rounded, not a huge jagged mountain. Match the previously viewed city artwork's texture and materials.
